requirements.acceptance_test: A low-context reader can state the purpose, object, and requested action, the leak fixture finds no forbidden internal register, and every released file traces to a source hash and version.
requirements.statement: Keep the reader-facing manuscript separate from the audit and provenance record, linked by immutable document and version identifiers; internal workflow vocabulary must not leak into the manuscript.
requirements.title: Reader-facing separation

requirements.acceptance_test: Conflict fixtures resolve in the declared order and LaTeX-specific configuration disables rules that would alter protected syntax.
requirements.statement: Resolve conflicts in the order correctness, source fidelity, domain meaning, reader comprehension, then template regularity; store project and format overrides in configuration rather than manuscript prose.
requirements.title: Configurable policy precedence

requirements.acceptance_test: Every diagnostic fixture returns stable locations and no command mutates its input; accepted edits are remeasured and recorded separately.
requirements.statement: Diagnostics emit categories, source spans, measurements, context, and editorial questions; only an explicit author or editor action may change text.
requirements.title: Located diagnostics without automatic rewriting

requirements.acceptance_test: Historical replay preserves a result for every layer and prevents a later-layer score from concealing an unresolved earlier defect.
requirements.statement: Diagnose and repair register leakage, mechanical repetition, defensive prose, substance, and reader comprehension in that order while retaining intermediate results.
requirements.title: Layered diagnosis and repair

requirements.acceptance_test: Repair replay produces zero unexplained protected-token changes and blocks promotion on any unexplained deletion, insertion, or mutation.
requirements.statement: Represent equations, labels, citations, numbers, claims, code, tables, and quoted text as protected content and explain every substantive change between versions.
requirements.title: Protected meaning-preserving diff

requirements.acceptance_test: Seeded valid, nonexistent, wrong-DOI, duplicate, and title-mismatch cases are classified correctly, and every load-bearing claim has a human-verified full-text anchor.
requirements.statement: Resolve bibliographic identity separately from source-to-claim support, retain a sentence-level claim anchor, and block release on an unresolved load-bearing citation.
requirements.title: Citation identity and claim support

requirements.acceptance_test: A frozen human-labelled set reports agreement and order, verbosity, and family-sensitivity diagnostics before a judge result can enter analysis.
requirements.statement: Use model judges only for construct-specific screening after pair-order randomization, length control, cross-family checking, and calibration against recorded human labels.
requirements.title: Calibrated model judging

requirements.acceptance_test: Every promoted document records the pseudonymous reader, immutable document hash, rubric response, decision, requested changes, and elapsed time.
requirements.statement: A human reader, not a surface metric or model judge, is the promotion authority for a specific document version.
requirements.title: Named human acceptance

requirements.acceptance_test: Tuning and holdout hashes are frozen before execution, each package has a human-labelled scorecard, and no smoke test is reported as effectiveness.
requirements.statement: Evaluate diagnostic packages and the complete workflow on documents not used for rule tuning, and separate surface, process, higher-order, and acceptance outcomes.
requirements.title: Held-out behavioral evaluation

requirements.acceptance_test: The release packet contains the required provenance records while the manuscript passes the internal-register leak test and a reader can identify the argument without process context.
requirements.statement: Use one bounded plan and one result record per work package; do not expose audit ledgers, gate names, or orchestration state in reader-facing prose.
requirements.title: Minimal process surface

requirements.acceptance_test: An unapproved remote route is blocked, approved calls produce a complete disclosure record, and the minimum-content retention policy is enforced.
requirements.statement: Keep protected manuscripts local by default and record provider, model, purpose, retention policy, disclosure status, and approval for every remote call.
requirements.title: Privacy and disclosure

requirements.acceptance_test: The drift command refuses single-document analysis, suppresses small cells, and reports uncertainty and baseline sensitivity for aggregate trends.
requirements.statement: Monitor aggregate vocabulary and structural convergence against an appropriate pre-assistance baseline, but never classify the authorship of an individual document.
requirements.title: Population-level convergence without attribution

requirements.acceptance_test: End-to-end replay reconstructs the intervention path from hashes and event records, distinguishes edited acceptance from direct acceptance, and applies the retention class.
requirements.statement: Record writer intent, suggestion, acceptance, edit, rejection, and rollback events without retaining unnecessary manuscript content.
requirements.title: Interaction telemetry

requirements.acceptance_test: The preregistered analysis reports uncertainty for each prespecified stratum and applies the stop rule if expert writers or a task class are harmed.
requirements.statement: Report effects by baseline writer skill, document task and genre, and reader role; do not deploy from an average effect that conceals subgroup harm.
requirements.title: Heterogeneous outcomes

requirements.acceptance_test: Pandoc, pylatexenc, plasTeX, LaTeXML, and tree-sitter candidates are benchmarked on malformed, unknown-macro, nested-environment, comment, math, citation, location, and round-trip fixtures before selection.
requirements.statement: All parser adapters must emit the same source-map and protected-span contract; no parser is authoritative merely because it accepts a document.
requirements.title: Format-aware parser contract

requirements.acceptance_test: Every adoption candidate has one provenance record and one explicit hold or adopt decision, and adoption is impossible unless its benchmark status is effectiveness-pass and independent review is recorded.
requirements.statement: Treat package availability, operational suitability, and writing effectiveness as separate decisions; only a held-out human-labelled benchmark supports adoption.
requirements.title: Evidence-tiered package adoption

requirements.acceptance_test: Seeded missing critical fields fail before writer invocation; complete briefs produce a stable hash and an explicit list of noncritical unknowns.
requirements.statement: Require the intended reader, decision, genre, known vocabulary, named exemplars, evidence boundary, privacy class, protected objects, and unresolved assumptions before long-form drafting; critical unknowns block the run.
requirements.title: Complete authoring brief

requirements.acceptance_test: Seeded missing warrants, use-before-teach concepts, duplicate section jobs, and figures without a teaching purpose block promotion; the plan has a stable hash.
requirements.statement: Compile a claim map, evidence anchors, concept-dependency graph, section jobs, terminology order, and visual plan before bounded drafting.
requirements.title: Argument blueprint before prose

requirements.acceptance_test: A unit can be rebuilt independently, records its prompt context and evidence anchors, and cannot advance the next unit while its own checks are unresolved.
requirements.statement: Give a replaceable writer one approved unit at a time with only the context and evidence named in the blueprint; widening a claim or inventing evidence requires an author decision.
requirements.title: Bounded evidence-constrained drafting

requirements.acceptance_test: Each seeded gate failure produces no reader packet, preserves a located repair record, and leaves the source available for inspection.
requirements.statement: Do not emit a human-review packet until integrity, argument, writing, evidence, and reconstruction gates pass or a named owner approves an explicit exception; missing or unknown results block release.
requirements.title: Fail-closed pre-human release

requirements.acceptance_test: A frozen held-out set reports false-positive, false-negative, order, verbosity, and family-sensitivity results before a critic enters the release path.
requirements.statement: Use isolated critics for concept order, evidence and scope, concrete mechanism, and low-context reconstruction; calibrate them on held-out human labels and never treat one model's self-assessment as certification.
requirements.title: Construct-specific preflight critics

requirements.acceptance_test: All critical deterministic mutations are caught or explicitly abstained from; rhetorical mutation rates and uncertainty are reported from a frozen test set.
requirements.statement: Inject known integrity, evidence, dependency, pacing, register, citation, and repair-oscillation failures into valid plans and drafts before trusting the release gate.
requirements.title: Adversarial mutation testing

requirements.acceptance_test: Seeded failures converge or stop with a located unresolved choice; no repair loop silently hands an unfinished document to the reader.
requirements.statement: Map each failed gate to a named repair strategy, rebuild and recheck within a fixed cycle limit, detect oscillation, and escalate an unresolved choice to the author.
requirements.title: Bounded causal repair

requirements.acceptance_test: The feasibility record reports first-draft release rate, author and reader minutes, abstentions, and meaning errors; no model score substitutes for the human outcome.
requirements.statement: Treat scarce expert reading time as a product constraint: release only after pre-human checks, measure escalations, repair cycles, reader time, and routine debugging avoided, and compare them with the incumbent workflow.
requirements.title: Human-attention budget
